problem:
Let $R=[-1,2]\times [-4,-1]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=3x-8y+6.$ Further, let 

$$
I={∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A
$$

be the unique number such that over all rectangular partitions $P$ of $R,$ we have 
$L(f,P)\,\le I\,\le U(f,P),$
where $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P)$ are the corresponding lower and upper Riemann sums, and 

$$
U(f,P)={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}\boxed{}\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\,.
$$

What expression is missing from the double summation above?

choices.value: None of the options is correct
